core.changelog:
- ✨ PPRuntimeStats.get_effective_stat() accepts exclude_source_prefix for filtered max computation
- ✨ PPNPCEntity built-in loot_table property + get_loot_table()/has_loot_table() API
- ✨ PPRecipeUtils.find_matching_recipe(inventory, type) convenience method
- 🔧 Fixed PPRuntimeStats._init() else branch dropping default stats
- 🔧 Fixed migration of corrupted 'undefined' extension properties on existing projects

premium.changelog:
- ✨ PPInventory now reads custom equipment slot names from Pandora option_property settings
- ✨ PPRuntimeStats.get_effective_stat() accepts exclude_source_prefix for filtered max computation
- ✨ PPNPCEntity built-in loot_table property + get_loot_table()/has_loot_table() API
- ✨ PPRecipeUtils.find_matching_recipe(inventory, type) convenience method
- 🔧 Fixed PPRuntimeStats._init() else branch dropping default stats
- 🔧 Fixed migration of corrupted 'undefined' extension properties on existing projects
